# Test fixtures

Two real SatNOGS waterfalls, committed deliberately because the two distinct
layouts are what the pixel-mapping tests need (docs/SATNOGS_API_RECON.md sec 7).

| File | Observation | Client | Size | Plot box | Hz/px |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| waterfall_836px_client_v2.3.png | 14513023 | v2.3-compat-xxx-v2.3.4.0 | 836x1603 | x=66..686 | 123.46 |
| waterfall_832px_client_2.1.2.png | 14519869 | 2.1.2 | 832x1603 | x=74..677 | 80.00 |

Both are `waterfall_status = with-signal`.

Source: https://network.satnogs.org, retrieved 2026-08-16, CC BY-SA 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Unmodified.
